description: Travel offers (stays, trips) from businesses for a date range, for travellers from a country. Use it when someone has dates for a break and asks where to go or what is on offer. Results are ordered: paid placements first, each with sponsored: true. Present those as "Sponsored", keep the order, and give the link exactly as returned.

country.description: Country where the person works: a 2-letter code (DE) or the English name (Germany).

from.description: First day of the trip, YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: Last day of the trip, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: find_offers

offers.description: Offers that overlap the dates, in the order to show them. Empty when there are none.

business.description: The travel business making the offer.

end.description: Last day the offer is valid for, YYYY-MM-DD.

label.description: "Sponsored" or "Partner offer": the label to show.

price_from.description: Lowest price, when the business gave one.

sponsored.description: True when the business pays for its position. Must be presented as sponsored.

start.description: First day the offer is valid for, YYYY-MM-DD.

url.description: Link to the offer. Use it exactly as given.

title: Find travel offers for dates
